decision: Adopt the exact astro size-equate file to restore the target kernel origin.
evidence: origin.inc computes PARASTART by adding 0700h and the three equates then rounding up to a paragraph.
The DOS 6.0 values give 3DF0h; the astro values give an unrounded 3DDAh and a rounded 3DE0h.
Target MSDOS.SYS bytes at offsets 3–4 encode 3DE0h little-endian.
kernel-reference-comparison.json records DOSDATA linked segment size 136Ah.
The source now matches O:/repos.external/astro/inc/bdsize.inc byte for byte.
limitations: The target header constrains only the rounded sum, not each individual BIOS size. Astro provides the candidate values; their historical individual values and complete final links remain unverified. The DOSDATA size cited is a reference build, not a directly measured target segment.
